According to computational analysis by DharmaNexus, the text shares extensive material with other Pali works, most notably the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (first part), with 34 matching passages including a primary parallel covering segments §1.1–7.3 [DharmaNexus]. In addition, it shares formulaic segments with several other biographical poems in the *Therāpadāna*, such as the *Suvaṇṇapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 117), the *Pupphacchattiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 331), the *Paccuggamaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 285), and the *Pupphacchadaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 136) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records a low-plausibility cross-language alignment between segment §3.2–3.3 and the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-amitābhavyūha-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra* (D0049) [DharmaNexus].
